scope: Edition, update, and ancient-commentary inventory for Enuma Anu Enlil lunar-eclipse Tablets 15-22; bibliographic access is not treated as passage inspection.

controlling_edition.citation: Francesca Rochberg-Halton, Aspects of Babylonian Celestial Divination: The Lunar Eclipse Tablets of Enuma Anu Enlil, AfO Beiheft 22 (1988), 296 pp.
controlling_edition.coverage: Tablets 15-22, transliteration, translation, and detailed commentary
controlling_edition.implementation_gate: No claim of complete Tablets 15-22 rule coverage until the full edition is legally acquired, hash-locked, and passage-inspected.

later_updates.citation: Jeanette C. Fincke, KASKAL 13 (2016), pp. 89-119, DOI 10.1400/251413
Jeanette C. Fincke, KASKAL 14 (2017), pp. 55-74, DOI 10.1400/257666
Jeanette C. Fincke, KASKAL 16 (2019), pp. 95-132, DOI 10.1400/278198

open_ancient_commentaries.base_text_scope: Primarily EAE 16 with final entries from EAE 19
open_ancient_commentaries.period: Achaemenid, year 19 of an Artaxerxes (445, 385, or 339 BCE)

open_ancient_commentaries.base_text_scope: EAE 21 sections II, IV, and VI

method_constraints: Ancient commentary is a distinct evidence layer and may redefine, restrict, or rationalize a base omen; it is never silently substituted for the base text.
A quoted base omen inside a commentary is scoped to that commentary witness unless independently collated against the controlling edition.
Alternative explanations remain alternatives, not cumulative conditions.
Broken predicates, uncertain tablet assignments, restored dates, and damaged geographical equations fail closed.
All state-omen and commentary outputs are historical-use-only, birth-input-ineligible, and customer-prediction-ineligible.
negative_search_result: The Internet Archive helper returned no exact Rochberg-Halton volume for focused title/author searches. CDLI, Google Books, Open Library, WorldCat, and NYPL verified the bibliography but did not supply an openly inspectable full edition.
